title: parity-store's tenant maps file, schema_version 1
description: Where each tenant lives (ARCHITECTURE.md §3.25): its tier and parent, its placement, its numbers and SIP domains. parity-store reads it at startup (--parity-store.maps-file; YAML, and JSON is YAML) and stops on an invalid file. The structure is here; the cross-tenant rules (unique ids and numbers and domains, parents, tiers, placements, and the test-file rules) are CONVENTIONS.md's 'Tenant maps', checked by contract-check and by parity-store with the same rule codes. tenant_id's format is defined here (parity-store owns it). A file with a 'test' section is test data: parity-store refuses it unless told to accept test data.

tenant_id.description: A DNS label: voice-api takes the tenant from the first label of a host name. Normative here (parity-store owns the format).

location_name.description: A zone, cell, deployment unit or media track name (eu1, eu1a, bin-a, blue). Not checked against a list yet.

name.description: The tenant's display name: a business name, never a person's. No control characters.

tier.description: Required on a tenant without a parent. A sub-tenant takes its parent's tier and may repeat it.

parent.description: The enterprise tenant this one belongs to (one level only).

numbers.description: The tenant's numbers (DIDs). Each belongs to one tenant across the platform.

sip_domains.description: The tenant's SIP domains, lowercase. Each belongs to one tenant across the platform.

placement.description: Where a tenant that takes traffic is served. A parent has none.

sip_domain.description: A lowercase host name of at least two labels.

test.description: Test data only (parity-contracts' tenants/test-tenants.v1.json). Its presence makes the file a test file: every number must be fictional and every SIP domain under a reserved name.

agents.description: Test agent ids per tenant: ids only, no secrets. Unique across the file.
